svg.text: Reinforcement Learning Optimization for Large-scale Learning - Alibaba / Taobao TMALL
Control flow decoupled from computation backends
Inspired by veRL HybridFlow + OpenRLHF + RAGEN (arXiv:2506.06122)
Actor Worker (train + gen) - Ref Worker - Critic Worker
Cluster = group of workers sharing same RL role
Orchestrate CPU/GPU resources - bind workers to devices
Colocated or disaggregated deployment per role
Parallel Strategy selects backend + parallelism per worker per stage (gen / infer / train)
Generation - Inference - Training per RL iteration (Actor/Critic/Ref/Reward)
Stage 1 GENERATION: Rollout Scheduler - Actor prefill/decode - Env Worker multi-turn
Async Reward Worker: rule verify / sandbox / LLM-as-Judge (no batch sync barrier)
Stage 2 INFERENCE: Critic + Ref + Reward forward (prefill only) - Transfer Protocol shard
Stage 3 TRAINING: Actor + Critic update - ModelUpdateGroup sync params to gen stage
Actor Train Cluster broadcasts bucketed params to Actor Infer Cluster (flexible device mapping)
GRPO/DAPO: Critic optional - dataflow graph activates only needed worker roles
200B+ MoE validated: thousands of GPUs x 2 weeks without interruption
Fine-grained per-prompt lifecycle vs batch-level scheduling in other frameworks
Observability: SwanLab / WandB / TensorBoard - per-domain reward tracking
Hardware: NVIDIA + AMD ROCm + Ascend NPU - cross-hardware friendly design
L6 - Production Validation (Taobao / TMALL / Alibaba AI Engine)
Doubao-scale RL - e-commerce search/recommendation agents - 200B+ MoE x 1000+ GPUs - fault tolerance
Init path: Resource Pool provision - AutoDeviceMapping - create Rollout Scheduler + Parallel Workers - Parallel Strategy
Step path: gen (scheduler) - async reward/env - infer (critic/ref) - train (actor/critic) - ModelUpdateGroup - repeat
Sources: alibaba/ROLL README - arXiv:2506.06122 - RollPacker arXiv:2509.21009 - ROLL Flash arXiv:2510.11345
